instruction: I need audio assistance to navigate the computer. Could you turn on the screen reader so it can read out what's on the screen?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: SCREEN_READER=$(timeout 10 gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-reader-enabled 2>/dev/null | grep -c true); if [ "$SCREEN_READER" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Screen reader enabled"; else echo "Screen reader not enabled"; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling screen reader (Orca) via Settings > Accessibility > Screen Reader. Evaluator checks screen-reader-enabled setting. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_line getter.
